title: Salesforce Developer
description: A roadmap for Salesforce careers: CRM fundamentals, admin basics, Apex, Lightning Web Components, integrations, automation, and portfolio orgs.

tree.name: Salesforce and CRM Foundations
tree.description: Understand CRM concepts, Salesforce clouds, objects, fields, records, security, automation, and business processes.

children.name: Admin Basics
children.description: Learn objects, fields, page layouts, profiles, permission sets, flows, reports, and validation rules.

children.name: Data Model and Security
children.description: Design object relationships, sharing rules, field-level security, role hierarchy, and record access.

tree.name: Apex and Lightning Web Components
tree.description: Build custom Salesforce behavior with Apex, SOQL, triggers, tests, LWC, events, and platform APIs.

resources.title: How to Become a Salesforce Developer in 100 Days (Salesforce Hulk)

children.name: Apex, SOQL, and Triggers
children.description: Write bulk-safe Apex, SOQL queries, triggers, services, governor-limit-aware logic, and unit tests.

children.name: Lightning Web Components
children.description: Create reusable UI components with JavaScript, templates, decorators, events, wire adapters, and LDS.

children.name: Practice: Governor Limit Refactor
children.description: Refactor a naive Apex flow to be bulk-safe, testable, secure, and ready for high-volume records.

tree.name: Integrations, DevOps, and Portfolio
tree.description: Connect Salesforce to external systems, manage releases, automate deployments, and build recruiter-visible projects.

children.name: APIs and Integrations
children.description: Use REST/SOAP APIs, callouts, named credentials, platform events, webhooks, and middleware patterns.

children.name: Project: Custom CRM App
children.description: Build a Salesforce app with custom objects, flows, Apex, LWC, tests, deployment notes, and a demo video.

tree.name: Enterprise Readiness
tree.description: Prepare for real Salesforce teams with governance, performance, security review habits, and certification direction.

children.name: Governor Limits and Performance
children.description: Design bulk-safe automations, avoid SOQL/DML limits, measure slow pages, and review async processing patterns.

children.name: Certification and Interview Prep
children.description: Prepare for Platform Developer I style topics, scenario interviews, debugging questions, and portfolio demos.

resources.title: Salesforce Platform Developer I Exam Guide
